verdict.rationale: Pinecone publishes machine-readable OpenAPI specs for every API surface, including data plane, control plane, inference, admin and oauth. Specific operations such as backups are documented as available through the SDK, API, or console, and the site says users can manage indexes from the console 'or stay in the terminal'. No source explicitly states full UI-to-API parity, and some functions (e.g., API key permission management, the no-code knowledge app publishing) are described only in console or UI terms. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that console-described features (API key permissions, no-code app publishing, monitoring) are API-accessible, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
